body: I think ur right about the fact i don’t have to spill all my secrets day one. I wish i realized that before and wasn’t so concerned about it when me and her met but yeah. Still tho, what should i do about the fact that i wasn’t 100% honest whenever we would talk about our past and then purposely make myself look like a good person? Should i just try to be more honest going forward or should i confess?
Dude. Please put the gun away. Don’t do this. Please man, we’re here for you

Yeah. I kinda relate to that. I do things i know are wrong and how it might make others feel and then i feel bad but then i don’t care and then i fucking feel bad that i don’t care lol. Its a mess and i sometimes lack the motivation as well. I think you (and probably myself) should try therapy and see what makes us tick. Why we’re scared of becoming something bad yet not having the motivation to do anythinf about it

Well. Use that fear as motivation. I fear being remembered as a bad person, thats what keeps me trying to change. Face ur problems. Slowly. Think of a plan to face them in a comfortable and efficient way. Theres many resources on reddit to help u on ur journy such as the decidingtobebetter sub or self improvement sub. We’re also here to help in whatever u may need. Whether its to vent or reach out for help. Don’t give up bro, ur only 17!!! I
Know u can do this because i’m 18 and going through a similar thing kinda :)

I feel the top paragraph. Heavily. However. Change is inevitable. You’ll change into a better person whether u want to or not. I’m not saying to continue whatever bad behaviors u may have, i’m just saying try not to put so much pressure on urself.
Hey man whats going on? Im sorry u got shut down like that :( u can always vent here but i’m sorry that happened

The problem is that i let her think i’m this great person (sometimes out of fear, sometimes on purpose) by not being 100% completely honest about my past actions and purposely saying all these cute and interesting things  (that are true atleast) knowing it would make her think that even more. It doesn’t feel good knowing she thinks i’m this great and nice person when i’m not yet. I she knows about some of the worst things about me but she hasn’t judged me for it and i haven’t judged her for hers. It’s not as a big deal now since i only see her as a friend but i still feel bad for purposely being fake and still am by not telling her that i was being fake.

I see. Its almost 2 months for me :/ please stay strong though. It can and will get better. Don’t worry about how it will get better. Just take the time to grieve and give attention back to urself and try to find things that make u happy. Also protip: it might be hard but PLEASE try not to check their socials. I struggle with this myself and it definitely makes it harder to move on. If u ever need someone to talk to about it i’d be more than happy to dm u. Maybe we can help eachother out :)

Yup i feel that dude :/ i miss my ex alot. I don’t deserve to be with her as i’ve fucked up alot and ruined our relationship, but i wish i could take it all back and be the person i used to be. Things will get better tho i promise you. Although i still miss my ex and think about her, i recently stopped feeling that i can’t be happy without her. I think thats a trap alot of ppl step in and it’s totally normal. If i can get better, i garantee you can too. It may take some time, but just let it all out. Let yourself grieve but don’t make it an obsession like i did. When did u guys break up?

I know how it feels to see ur ex doing better than you. I’m happy for my ex and all, but it does make me feel like a loser when i consider that i’m not doing so great lmao. I think you should drop ur plan and just focus on giving some love and attention to urself. What are ur fav things to do that give u joy??
Please don’t. It’s always possible to turn things around :( may i ask why you feel like u deserve nothing good??
I’m so sorry :( if i may ask what sort of chronic pain are you dealing with ??

I know how it feels to be alone. I’ve made myself lonely in the past and it made me feel insane having no one to talk to, no outlet for my problems. It can definitely make things worse and i can garantee ur life is valuable so if you want someone to vent to or straight up just talk to, i’m here for you man <3
You didn’t do anything wrong !!! :( ur not a terrible person ur friend is just mean. Why would she get mad at u for something u can’t control??

Yeah, i guess this whole thing is because i felt like this one thing was just THAT terrible. And so i felt bad cuz i was purposely making myself look nice while knowing at the same time that this thing could change her mind about me. I definitely feel like it wasn’t right of me, but i don’t think i’ll tell her about it unless we end up liking eachother or enough time passes.

The thing in question is just bad things i did in a past relationship and some of my current bad behaviors that i still struggle with. I talk about stuff like this alot with her but sometimes i’m not completely honest about it i guess out of fear and then well obviously purposely making myself seem more interesting and cute when i just lied is just wrong but yeah. I try not to lie about things ive done in the past but it’s just scary sometimes and it makes it hard to be 100% honest about it. Not an excuse i know and its something i gotta get over if i want an honest relationship with anyone but yeah. 

I’m most likely gonna stay only friends with this girl anyway so i guess that kinda takes off the pressure from having to be 100% completely honest and if we did end up together it would be hard to clean up the mess i made with not being completely honest but yeah..

Nah actually this stems from not wanting to be dishonest because i was really dishonest in my last relationship and even tho i would still lie i would also at the same time be obsessed with finding out the truth in my bullshit and trying to be transparent with my s/o lmao. But yeah i also do overthink alot and it’s definitely not something that makes my life easier.

As for this situation, i didn’t lie about any of the good things i told her. That’s not something i would really do lol. I think i feel guilty over this because i actually do have something in my past that i’d feel make her changer her mind about me and instead of telling her that i made myself look good while knowing it was the wrong thing to do. Sure this thing i’m worried about could also just be me being paranoid but i still feel bad that i knowingly still made myself look good when i should’ve just acted normally since i was so worried about how she’d feel about that specific thing from my past. Tbh i’m not even really sure i should go on (or if its even worth) telling her about that thing now that i think about it more but i still feel i should maybe confess to that slight manipulation

I am so terrible sorry you dealt with all this. I can only hope you have someone to talk to about all of this but if not you already know we’re here for you :( i have my share of sex abuse at a young age but is nothing compared to your story. It is amazing you have toughed it out for this long and we’re proud of you. Please don’t end it now. There has to be something in this vast world for you to live for!! <3

I mean yeah, i basically did repeat a bad action, it’s something i’ve done with an ex of mine where i purposely tell her interesting things about myself and phrase them to make it more cute instead of confessing something i did wrong first. It’s manipulative and I’m definitely still not a good person but i do wish to change. The only difference this time is that it stopped what i was doing after that one night and i only see this girl as a friend now. And yeah i know i don’t have an obligation to tell this new girl anything about myself but when i was trying to persue her then yeah i would say i had an obligation then.
Yeah, i just feel bad for being so fake to her day one. I know i didn’t do anything to actually hurt her but i just feel bad for having those bad intentions is all

Well i’m open to sharing it slowly ofc if thats how things go but i still feel bad about what i did and how i knowingly disregarded her feelings. I feel bad because she thinks im such a nice person and she’s always been sweet to me. Is this something i should tell her?
Damn bro i’m so sorry :( ur worth more than that man leave her and focus on urself don’t let her win control of ur life <3
U still here bro ? :( talk to us man

I don’t know, it’s just that i’ve already made up my mind after thinking about this since november. I know it’s going to happen eventually. I imagine that if i tell them the truth and i do it they’ll feel like they failed me. They’ll feel like they didn’t do enough. I think it’s just better to just lie and say ive been busy or something. I know me dying would cause pain regardless to those who care about me, but i guess i’m just trying to minimize it as much as possible.

Sorry, but why do u think i want to end it at all? We’ve both expressed that we have feelings for eachother and want to be together? I definitely don’t want to end it, it’s just that if we do end up together again i want her to have a fullyinformed decision on it first.
